positive_cases.name: disable_realtime_monitoring
positive_cases.scenario: Management module invoked to disable real-time monitoring.
positive_cases.rationale: Tool image and weakening option selections both match.

positive_cases.name: policy_registry_write
positive_cases.scenario: Registry utility used to write a protection-disabling policy value.
positive_cases.rationale: Tool image and weakening option selections both match.

negative_cases.name: enable_realtime_monitoring
negative_cases.scenario: Protection re-enabled after a maintenance window.
negative_cases.rationale: The switch value differs and the weakening keyword is absent.

negative_cases.name: query_protection_status
negative_cases.rationale: Tool matches but the command line contains no weakening keyword.

negative_cases.name: documentation_tool_mentions_setting
negative_cases.scenario: Documentation generator referencing the setting name in a report path.
negative_cases.rationale: The keyword appears but the image is not one of the configuration tools.

notes: All events are synthetic. Negative cases are deliberate near misses that exercise one failing selection each.
